name: External Penetration Test Report
objective: Index independent cybersecurity infrastructure scans, discovered system vulnerability counts, CVE rankings, and fix steps.

attributes.name: Testing Vendor
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the penetration testing firm name.

attributes.name: Test Date
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the date(s) testing was performed.

attributes.name: Scope
attributes.extractionPrompt: Summarise the systems / assets in scope.

attributes.name: Critical Findings
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the count of critical-severity findings.

attributes.name: High Findings
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the count of high-severity findings.

attributes.name: Medium Findings
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the count of medium-severity findings.

attributes.name: Low Findings
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the count of low-severity findings.

attributes.name: Vulnerabilities
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract each finding: title, CVE/CVSS, severity, affected asset, remediation.

attributes.name: Overall Risk Rating
attributes.extractionPrompt: Classify overall risk (Critical, High, Medium, Low).

attributes.name: Retest Required
attributes.extractionPrompt: Indicate whether a retest is required.
